description:
Public Pinterest profile: name, about, website, verification and follower/following/pin/board/video-pin counts.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), full_name (string), about (string), website_url (string, nullable), domain (string, nullable), is_verified (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), pin_count (integer, nullable), board_count (integer, nullable), video_pin_count (integer, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable).

username.description: Pinterest username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "nasa"

name: pinterest_profile
title: Pinterest profile
